source_register: Dossier section 12: 35 public primary-source references with acquisition limits.
scope: Selective research examples, not a complete supplier universe, approved schema, security master, forecast, clinical recommendation or investment recommendation.
identifier_scope: All IDs, archetypes, example states and source keys are document-local. Reuse existing canonical owners in any later implementation.
unknowns_policy: Every entity inherits unknown materiality and exact security identity unless explicitly established in the record. Missing values are not zero or evidence of no relationship.

materiality_default.reason: No calibrated company-wide or security-level materiality estimate established; reported segment mix is a separate measure.

security_identity_default.reason: Names are research entities, not verified current instruments or approved basket members.

Prospectus announcement is not closing proof

measurement_examples.measure: Issuer FCF definition with interest/asset adjustments

scenario_examples.question: Which exact presentation is displaced and which demand is incremental?
scenario_examples.required: Molecule/formulation, paid adoption, attachment, supplier contract and net economics
scenario_examples.abstain: Do not remove all injection-related exposure or treat all oral manufacturing as identical

scenario_examples.question: Does a named activity move, and do qualified supplies remain externally sourced?
scenario_examples.required: Contract scope, actual site qualification, timing and supplier participation
scenario_examples.abstain: A factory announcement cannot identify which vendor loses fees or gains orders

scenario_examples.question: Can volume improve while scarcity premium or incremental return falls?
scenario_examples.required: Qualified supply, utilization, price, reinvestment and contrary demand evidence
scenario_examples.abstain: No industry-wide oversupply or shortage conclusion from one project

scenario_examples.question: What happens to input consumption per treatment and platform attachment?
scenario_examples.required: Documented workflow change, consumption, substitution and commercial adoption
scenario_examples.abstain: Supplier revenue growth is not mechanically equal to drug growth

scenario_examples.question: Which ex-vivo, processing or logistics activity actually changes?
scenario_examples.required: Stage-comparable clinical and commercial evidence plus contract scope
scenario_examples.abstain: Early results or a broad cell-therapy tag do not establish displaced revenue

scenario_examples.question: How do conditional ownership, consideration and funding alter per-share exposure?
scenario_examples.required: Current ownership, conditions, financing and effective-date receipts
scenario_examples.abstain: Do not infer closing, certain contingent payment, or undiluted buyer benefit

adversarial_specifications.reject: All announced capacity is operational
adversarial_specifications.require: Separate announced, qualified and commercial stages

adversarial_specifications.reject: Production beginning proves profitable utilization
adversarial_specifications.require: Retain ramp cost and demand uncertainty

adversarial_specifications.reject: Headline capex equals cash capital purchases
adversarial_specifications.require: Use the statement's appropriate cash components

adversarial_specifications.reject: Every FCF label has the same definition
adversarial_specifications.require: Preserve the issuer and normalized reconciliation separately

adversarial_specifications.reject: All reported EBITDA is recurring
adversarial_specifications.require: Identify asset-sale income and cost adjustments symmetrically

adversarial_specifications.reject: Receivables growth proves bad economics or no demand
adversarial_specifications.require: Test collection timing, cash and underlying activity

adversarial_specifications.reject: Customer prepayments are recurring earnings
adversarial_specifications.require: Preserve cash timing and remaining obligations

adversarial_specifications.reject: Cash takeover requires no buyer equity financing
adversarial_specifications.require: Read proposed funding separately from consideration

adversarial_specifications.reject: Anonymous ADC customer is the best-known developer
adversarial_specifications.require: Leave customer unresolved

adversarial_specifications.reject: Parent and subsidiary revenues are additive market demand
adversarial_specifications.require: Show ownership and avoid operating overlap

adversarial_specifications.reject: Voting rights equal share-capital ownership
adversarial_specifications.require: Keep distinct percentages and sources

adversarial_specifications.reject: Pall Life Sciences and Cytiva create independent current stocks
adversarial_specifications.require: Resolve business and investable parent

adversarial_specifications.reject: Core growth versus competitor CC growth proves share gain
adversarial_specifications.require: Comparable periods, products, definitions and denominator

adversarial_specifications.reject: Temporary purchasing is a permanent production run rate
adversarial_specifications.require: Separate inventory timing from underlying demand

adversarial_specifications.reject: Merck KGaA is US Merck & Co.
adversarial_specifications.require: Canonical company identity before mapping

adversarial_specifications.reject: Group life-science revenue is pure bioprocess exposure
adversarial_specifications.require: Business scope and eliminations

adversarial_specifications.reject: Royalty growth proves the entire platform is growing
adversarial_specifications.require: Show core and downstream components

adversarial_specifications.reject: Genentech license covers all in-vivo therapies
adversarial_specifications.require: Preserve selected ex-vivo scope and undisclosed terms

adversarial_specifications.reject: Fixed share exchange is fixed cash value
adversarial_specifications.require: Separate cash and buyer-share components

adversarial_specifications.reject: Acquisition announcement proves current ownership
adversarial_specifications.require: Closing receipt or explicit uncertainty

adversarial_specifications.reject: Wilson Wolf is fully owned today or only an optional future purchase
adversarial_specifications.require: Minority equity method plus triggered forward obligation

adversarial_specifications.reject: Supported-trial count is approval probability or equal revenue
adversarial_specifications.require: Treat it as a workflow support measure

adversarial_specifications.reject: CRYOPDP remains in current Cryoport operating footprint
adversarial_specifications.require: Respect continuing-operation divestiture perimeter

adversarial_specifications.reject: SmartDose accounting comparison proves transfer closed
adversarial_specifications.require: Separate agreement, reporting treatment and effective date

adversarial_specifications.reject: 51% of BDS means 51% of the group
adversarial_specifications.require: Carry numerator and denominator

adversarial_specifications.reject: Alina's liraglutide example identifies semaglutide or tirzepatide
adversarial_specifications.require: Retain disclosed molecule and unnamed customer

adversarial_specifications.reject: All fiscal Q3 records cover the same months
adversarial_specifications.require: Explicit period boundaries

adversarial_specifications.reject: QC product launch or research agreement proves paid adoption
adversarial_specifications.require: Keep capability, research, regulatory and commercial evidence apart

adversarial_specifications.reject: Add assumed debt twice or treat contingent consideration as certain
adversarial_specifications.require: Use transaction bridge and conditional obligations

adversarial_specifications.reject: Flat issuer revenue means no accelerating subtheme
adversarial_specifications.require: Inspect measured sub-business and comparison effects

adversarial_specifications.reject: Preclinical Pb-212 agreement proves commercial therapy supply
adversarial_specifications.require: Keep stage, product qualification and volumes unresolved

adversarial_specifications.reject: A named supplier or private business is automatically a public basket constituent
adversarial_specifications.require: Verify security identity and authorized membership separately
